title: Zesty British Fennel Spotted Dick Pudding
description: A plant-based friendly British dessert featuring fennel seeds, perfect for a post-workout treat, with a unique blend of earthy and springy flavors. This spotted dick pudding is steamed in a hot pot vessel to create a moist and delicious dessert.
instructions: Preheat the steamer by filling the hot pot vessel with water and bringing it to a boil.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, fennel seeds, and sugar.
Add the dried fruit, plant-based milk, vegetable oil, and vanilla extract to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Transfer the dough to a greased pudding basin or a heatproof bowl that fits inside the hot pot vessel.
Cover the pudding with a piece of parchment paper or aluminum foil and tie it with string.
Place the pudding in the hot pot vessel, making sure it is fully submerged in the boiling water.
Steam the pudding for 2 hours, or until it is cooked through and firm to the touch.
Remove the pudding from the hot pot vessel and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the pudding warm, garnished with additional fennel seeds if desired.
